label: Treasure Hunter
tooltip: Coffer lines on the map and Treasure Hunt routes.

draw_line_to_bronze_chests.label: Lines to bronze coffers
draw_line_to_bronze_chests.tooltip: While out of combat, draw a brown line from you to nearby bronze coffers.

draw_line_to_silver_chests.label: Lines to silver coffers
draw_line_to_silver_chests.tooltip: While out of combat, draw a silver line from you to nearby silver coffers.

draw_line_to_carrots.label: Lines to carrots
draw_line_to_carrots.tooltip: While out of combat, draw a green line from you to nearby carrots.

show_percentage_active_treasure_count.label: Show remaining coffers as %
show_percentage_active_treasure_count.tooltip: Adds a percentage next to Active bronze / Active silver on the Treasure tab.

return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.label: Cast Return after hunt
return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.tooltip: After Treasure Hunt or Carrot Hunt finishes. Off while Loop Carrot Hunt is running between passes.

loop_carrot_hunt.label: Loop Carrot Hunt
loop_carrot_hunt.tooltip: Carrot Hunt only. Skip empty pads; after each Fortune Carrot, check every pad again. If a full pass finds none, keep checking until Stop or you run out of carrots.

play_sound_on_hunt_complete.label: Play sound when Treasure Hunt finishes
play_sound_on_hunt_complete.tooltip: Play an MP3 when Treasure Hunt finishes.

hunt_complete_sound.label: Hunt finished sound
hunt_complete_sound.tooltip: Pick an MP3 from the plugin Sounds folder. Click a name to preview it.
hunt_complete_sound.open_folder: Open sound folder — drop MP3s here to add your own.

cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.label: Cast Treasure Sight during hunt
cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.tooltip: Cast Treasure Sight at the start, then every N locations. Stops early if Sight says nothing is left.

treasure_sight_every_n_locations.label: Treasure Sight every N locations
treasure_sight_every_n_locations.tooltip: After the first cast, recast every this many locations checked (opened or empty).

hunt_max_level.label: Max coffer level
hunt_max_level.tooltip: Skip coffers whose nearby enemies are above this level. 50 = no limit.

hunt_silver_chests_only.label: Silver coffers only
hunt_silver_chests_only.tooltip: Treasure Hunt only visits silver coffers and skips bronze pads.

hunt_min_bronze_percent.label: Min bronze fill to auto-hunt (%)
hunt_min_bronze_percent.tooltip: With Treasure Sight: auto-hunts (Illegal Mode + Mob Farmer timer) start when bronze fill is at least this % of 30 — or when silver meets its own %. Without Sight, Illegal Mode uses the built-in map and ignores this.

hunt_min_silver_percent.label: Min silver fill to auto-hunt (%)
hunt_min_silver_percent.tooltip: With Treasure Sight: auto-hunts start when silver fill is at least this % of 8 — or when bronze meets its own %. Without Sight, Illegal Mode uses the built-in map and ignores this.

empty_pad_trust_distance.label: Empty pad check distance
empty_pad_trust_distance.tooltip: How close (yalms) to walk before treating a coffer pad as empty and moving on. Default 25. Lower = walk closer (safer when coffers load late); higher = skip from farther away.

skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.label: Skip dangerous weather / Ashkin
skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.tooltip: Pause Treasure Hunt on South Horn during Ashkin or other unsafe weather windows.

use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.label: Ninja Hide near strong enemies
use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.tooltip: Near a high-Knowledge enemy, swap to Ninja, Hide, and walk the last stretch to the coffer.

use_occult_sprint_while_hidden.label: Occult Sprint while Hidden
use_occult_sprint_while_hidden.tooltip: While Hidden, switch to Phantom Thief and cast Occult Sprint for a big speed boost.

ninja_gearset_number.label: Ninja gearset number
ninja_gearset_number.tooltip: Gearset number that equips Ninja (as shown in the gearset list, starting at 1). 0 = do not swap — you must already be on Ninja.

knowledge_hide_offset.label: Hide vs enemies this many Knowledge above you
knowledge_hide_offset.tooltip: Hide when a nearby enemy's Knowledge is at least yours plus this. Higher = only stronger enemies. Negative = also weaker ones. Uses your real Knowledge, not the synced South Horn value. 0 = same Knowledge or higher.

knowledge_threat_enter_distance.label: Start Hide within (yalms)
knowledge_threat_enter_distance.tooltip: Begin Hide when a dangerous enemy is this close.

knowledge_threat_exit_distance.label: Keep Hide until farther than (yalms)
knowledge_threat_exit_distance.tooltip: Once Hide is on, keep it until enemies are farther than this.
